summary: Intercure Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing its 2025 annual results: revenue of over NIS 270 million, net loss of NIS 37 million, Adjusted EBITDA of NIS 47 million, and positive operating cash flow of NIS 17 million. The filing also notes CEO Alex Rabinovitch purchased over 500,000 shares and Yaron Jacobi became a significant shareholder. This is a routine earnings release; no transaction, restructuring, or other special situation is reported. The 6-K serves as a foreign private issuer's equivalent of an earnings press release.
